current_staged_candidate.why_high_information: Unlike rejected selection, re-entry, direct-loss allocation and book-sparsity families, this candidate changes the timing of the severe systemic multiplier while still using the existing ordinary two-session relief on the first close. That directly addresses the single-symbol holding-continuity witness without removing risk relief.

pre_economics_correctness_review.preregistered_rule: If the same close-known severe trigger remains true on a later close while the shock episode is active, escalate then to the existing severe systemic stress calculation. Queued first-stage sells create no credit.
pre_economics_correctness_review.implemented_rule: shock_persisted is true only when shock_trigger && shock_episode_active && bool(shock_reduced_books); therefore severe escalation additionally requires at least one first-stage fill identity.
pre_economics_correctness_review.exact_patch_expression: shock_persisted = shock_trigger and shock_episode_active and bool(shock_reduced_books)
pre_economics_correctness_review.consequence_when_severe_persists_before_: shock_persisted=false; reduction_suspended=true; this planner schedules no incremental severe relief on that close. Existing first-stage pending sells may remain elsewhere, but they do not cover the additional severe amount and are not risk credit.
pre_economics_correctness_review.missing_red_case: Run the same persistent-severe fixture with shock_episode_active=true, severe trigger still present, zero shock_reduced_book_ids, and the first-stage sells still pending/unfilled. The policy must remain fail-closed and must not silently defer the additional severe requirement merely because fills have not occurred.
pre_economics_correctness_review.scope_note: This is a state-transition/correctness blocker for the candidate identity, not evidence that the staged timing hypothesis is economically false. Do not infer a market-path occurrence from this deterministic boundary alone.

decision.main_research_direction: Keep the staged severe-timing hypothesis as the highest-information active alpha test, but correct or explicitly reconcile its fill-gated escalation with the preregistered fail-closed contract before economic interpretation.
decision.next_after_boundary: If the exact staged source passes the missing pending/unfilled persistent-severe state transition, run only its already preregistered continuous paths and evaluate primary01/03, protected05/13/17,06/07/08 adjacency and known-random risk. If it fails that correctness boundary, fix the engineering semantics under the same preregistered economic mechanism before any replay; do not compensate with a new gate or parameter.

acceptance: NOT_MET; no new economic run, no full958, no formal random P90, no production promotion and no merge claim.
